messages:
Maria: Hey team — prepping the Pulse Deck for LoomingCo exec readout next Wed. Need slide owners + callouts: account health, onboarding status, renewal risks, enablement asks, and a short exec recommendation. Dry run Friday — prefer 11am. Who can own which slide?

Jamal: I can own Health + Renewal Risk matrix. Need the ARR churn numbers from Billing to populate the risk bands.

Ethan: I'll take Onboarding status + migration timeline. Will pull taskboard and include a contingency lane for delays.

Sara: I'll own Enablement outcomes and ask list. Can someone share the latest activation funnel so I can pull adoption metrics? @Priya? :eyes: 

onboarding-bot: Export ready -> https://notion.company/loomingco/onboarding-export.csv (created by onboarding-bot)

Priya: I have the funnel. DM'ing the CSV and will drop into the deck folder. Also can provide one short customer quote for the slides.

Maria: Thanks. Jamal — include a 3-line exec summary on renewal risk and one recommended mitigation (keep slide to 1 visual + 2 bullets).

Jamal: Will do. One potential risk to call out: delayed SSO rollout may push cutover and affect adoption. Mitigation: schedule co-managed rollout support week of 5/12. :warning:

Ethan: For timeline, confirm if we should show the delayed SSO in the main lane or in a contingency lane? I can add a contingency swimlane if yes. Also need dev completion ETA from Eng PM.

Maria: Show it in contingency lane + add a one-line impact statement. Ethan — can you confirm dev completion date by Thursday COB?

Ethan: Yes — I'll confirm by Thu COB. Small blocker: infra capacity confirmation from Eng-Infra. Pinged them in #eng-infra.

Sara: For enablement slide I'm proposing three asks: 1) dedicated office hours, 2) tailored playbook + one-pager, 3) two co-browse sessions. Need cost/time estimate for co-browse to include as an ask.

Maria: Jamal, can you add a rough cost estimate for co-browse hours to your notes? Keep it high level (one bullet).

Jamal: Estimate ~12 engineer hours + 4 enablement hours (rough). Will add to slide notes and the appendix.

Priya: I'll add a one-sentence customer quote + NPS sparkline. Also attaching the activation funnel screenshot to the slide folder.

Maria: Great. Summarizing owners & due dates: 
- Jamal: Health + Renewal risk + cost estimate (due Thu COB)
- Ethan: Onboarding timeline + contingency lane (due Thu COB)
- Sara: Enablement asks + playbook draft (due Fri EOD)
- Priya: Customer quote + activation data (due Thu COB)
- Maria: Compile deck, polish narrative, run dry run Fri 11am

Sara: Conflict at 11 — can we do 10:30 instead? :slightly_smiling_face:

Maria: 10:30 works. I'll update the invite.

Jamal: Adding a tracking card in Notion for owners and action items now.

onboarding-bot: Notion card created: https://notion.company/loomingco/pulse-deck-track (card #4821)

Ethan: Small ask for the Eng slide — include one-liner on fallback routing if latency regresses (we want execs to know we have a fallback). I'll stub that.

Priya: Also think we should call out two prioritized product asks from the execs for visibility. I'll capture top 2 from customer feedback.

Maria: Yes — capture product asks in the appendix and call out the top 2 on the final slide. Keep them concise.

Sara: I'll attach the playbook draft and the office hours proposal into the deck folder once ready.

Maria: Perfect. Everyone: drop final slides into the folder by your due date. I'll do a last-pass narrative edit Thursday night. See you at the dry run Friday 10:30. :thumbsup:
